The [[Viidaav (species)|Viidaavs]] founded a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] '''colony''' on the surface of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Viidaav]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] bought [[Ore/Legends|ore]] mined in the colony.
